alt: Four Lead II rhythm strips stacked on ECG grid paper: normal sinus rhythm with a P wave before every evenly spaced QRS; atrial fibrillation with unevenly spaced QRS and a wavy baseline; ventricular fibrillation with chaotic waves and no QRS; asystole as a nearly flat line.
caption: Normal sinus rhythm, atrial fibrillation, ventricular fibrillation (shockable) and asystole (not shockable)
